title: Apple Will 'Watch Everything Burn' When AI Bubble Bursts - Slashdot

content_html:
MacRumors interviewed AI critic Ed Zitron, author of the Where's Your Ed At newsletter and host of the Better Offline podcast, about what could happen to Apple if the costly AI infrastructure boom collapses. Zitron argued that Apple is relatively well insulated because it has spent far less on data centers than rivals such as Microsoft, Google, and Amazon. He said the company could use the downturn to make selective acquisitions, though it might simply continue operating largely as before. "I think they will sit on the sidelines and watch everything burn," Zitron said. Here's an excerpt from the report: If the bubble deflates the way you expect (write-downs, too much compute supply, possibly OpenAI cratering), can you walk us through what that would actually look like for Apple? Does anything break for iPhone users, or does Apple mostly watch it happen from the sidelines? Could it even benefit Apple?

I think things would look much the same for Apple. I think they will sit on the sidelines and watch everything burn. I could see them doing some choice acquisitions as things begin to collapse, but I could also see them do nothing.

I think Apple is in a very weird place at the moment. The Vision Pro was a dud, but it was also the most interesting and future-forward thing I've seen anyone put out in a while. If they were smart, they'd tread water and sink as much money into making that as small as humanely possible -- no matter how long it takes -- because the entire AI bubble is a result of everybody running out of hypergrowth ideas, mostly because we're flat out of new interfaces.

I want to be clear that what they want to do with the Vision Pro requires it to basically be weightless and invisible and never need adjustments. When it works, it's genuinely awesome. But that's a load-bearing when. One slight movement means the whole thing goes out of focus. I can't even use mine anymore because it needs an update that requires you to wear the thing the whole time. So much promise, released too early, shoved out the door by a CEO on his way out.

content_html_zh: MacRumors 采访了 AI 评论家 Ed Zitron，他是《Where's Your Ed At》时事通讯的作者，也是 Better Offline 播客的主持人，探讨了如果成本高昂的 AI 基础设施繁荣崩溃，苹果可能会发生什么。 Zitron 认为，苹果的隔离能力相对较好，因为它在数据中心上的支出远低于微软、谷歌和亚马逊等竞争对手。 他表示，该公司可以利用经济低迷时期进行选择性收购，尽管它可能只是像以前一样继续运营。 “我认为他们会袖手旁观，看着一切燃烧，”齐特伦说。 以下是该报告的摘录：如果泡沫按照您预期的方式破灭（资产减记、计算供应过多、可能是 OpenAI 陷入困境），您能否向我们介绍一下苹果公司的实际情况？ iPhone 用户是否会遇到什么问题，或者苹果是否只是袖手旁观？ 它还能让苹果受益吗？ 我认为苹果公司的情况也差不多。 我认为他们会袖手旁观，看着一切燃烧。 我可以看到他们在事情开始崩溃时进行一些选择性收购，但我也可以看到他们什么也不做。 我认为苹果目前处于一个非常奇怪的境地。 Vision Pro 是个失败品，但它也是我一段时间以来见过的最有趣、最有未来感的产品。 如果他们聪明的话，他们就会脚踏实地，投入尽可能多的钱，把它做得尽可能小——无论需要多长时间——因为整个人工智能泡沫是每个人都耗尽了高速增长的想法的结果，主要是因为我们已经没有新的界面了。 我想澄清的是，他们想要用 Vision Pro 做的事情要求它基本上是失重和隐形的，并且永远不需要调整。 当它起作用时，它真的很棒。 但这是一个承重的时候。 一个轻微的动作就意味着整个事物都失去了焦点。 我什至不能再使用我的了，因为它需要更新，需要你一直戴着它。 如此多的承诺，过早地被释放，被一位首席执行官在离职时推到了门外。
